text:
Have you not read, my love,

in NOVEDADES:


SENTINEL OF PEACE

GENIUS OF LABOR

CHAMPION OF DEMOCRACY

IN AMERICA

DEFENDER OF CATHOLICISM

IN AMERICA

THE PROTECTOR OF THE PEOPLE

THE BENEFACTOR...?


They plunder the people

of their language.


And they falsify the words

of the people.


(Exactly like the

people's money)


That is why poets

polish a poem so much


And that is why

my love poems are so important.

translation.title: Have You Not Read, My Love...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the propaganda headlines and the turn toward poetry as linguistic resistance.
